Yes—within limits.

I can answer sexual health and sexuality questions in an educational, respectful way (e.g., anatomy, consent, contraception, STI prevention, sexual function, relationship communication).  

I can’t provide pornographic/explicit content meant for arousal, detailed “how-to” instructions for sex acts, or anything involving minors, coercion, or non-consent.

If you tell me what you’re wondering about (and confirm you’re 18+ if it’s about adult sexual activity), I’ll help.
